auth.failure.unreadableResponse: The server's response couldn't be read. Check the address and try again.
auth.failure.tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Try again in a moment.
auth.failure.serverError: The server ran into an error. Try again in a moment.
auth.join.guestPaused: Guest invites are paused until per-channel invites are ready. Contact a workspace admin.
auth.join.invalidCode: This invite code isn't valid. Ask the person who invited you to check the link again.
auth.join.expired: This invite has expired. Ask a workspace admin for a new invite link.
auth.join.revoked: This invite was revoked. Ask a workspace admin for a new invite link.
auth.join.unusable: This invite can no longer be used. Ask a workspace admin for a new invite link.
auth.join.alreadyRedeemed: This account has already joined with this invite. Sign in instead.
auth.join.exhausted: This invite has been used up. Ask a workspace admin for a new invite link.
auth.join.cannotJoin: You can't join with this invite. Ask a workspace admin for a new invite link.
auth.join.notPermitted: This invite doesn't give you permission to join. Ask a workspace admin for a new invite link.
auth.join.unmapped: The request couldn't be processed. Ask a workspace admin for a new invite link.
auth.signIn.unmapped: The request couldn't be processed. Contact a workspace admin.
auth.signIn.invalidCredentials: The email or password doesn't match.
auth.signIn.workspaceIdFormat: That isn't a workspace ID. Leave it empty to connect to the default workspace.
auth.signIn.suspended: This account can't sign in right now. Contact a workspace admin.
auth.claim.invalidLink: This link isn't valid. Open the address exactly as you received it.
auth.claim.expired: This link has expired. Ask whoever ran the install for a new link.
auth.claim.used: This link has already been used. Sign in instead.
auth.claim.passwordRecheck: Check the password again. It is empty or too long.
auth.claim.unmapped: The request couldn't be processed. Check the address you received and try again.
auth.passwordRule.tooShort: The password is too short. Use at least {minChars, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}.
auth.passwordRule.tooLong: The password is too long. Use {maxBytes} bytes or fewer. A Hangul character takes {hangulBytes} bytes (up to {maxHangul} characters if only Hangul).
auth.deviceLink.expired: This connection code has expired or isn't recognized.
auth.deviceLink.used: This connection code has already been used.
auth.deviceLink.malformed: That isn't a connection code. Scan the QR code again.
auth.deviceLink.sasWait: This continues once you confirm on the desktop.
auth.deviceLink.permission: Camera access is off, so the QR code can't be scanned. Connect with the address instead.
auth.deviceLink.unreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Trying to connect again.
auth.deviceLink.qrInstruction: Point the camera at the QR code on the desktop screen.
auth.deviceLink.cameraError: Couldn't open the camera. Connect with the address instead.
auth.deviceKey.cancelled: Touch ID or passcode confirmation was canceled.
auth.deviceKey.authFailed: Couldn't verify it's you. Try again.
auth.deviceKey.unsignedBuild: This build isn't signed, so it can't use a Secure Enclave key. Use the team release app.
auth.deviceKey.entitlementMissing: This build doesn't have permission to keep a signing key. Use the team release app.
auth.deviceKey.unsupported: This device can't create a command-signing key.
auth.deviceKey.changed: This Mac's signing key has changed. Register this Mac as a signing device again.
auth.deviceKey.notRootHere: This Mac isn't registered as a signing device for this workspace.
auth.deviceKey.payloadRejected: It wasn't signed because the content has invisible characters or an invalid value.
auth.deviceKey.hostPinnedOther: This Mac's work host already has a different key registered as the signing device. Register the work host again.
auth.deviceKey.pinRefused: This Mac's work host didn't accept this key as the signing device. Check the work host status.
auth.deviceKey.kindNotEnabled: This app can't make this kind of signature yet.
auth.deviceKey.noLetter: There's no revocation signed on this Mac, so it can't be sent again.
auth.deviceKey.notEndorsedHere: This Mac has no record of approving this key, so it can't sign the revocation. Disconnecting that device revokes the key on the server, but this Mac's work host won't be told.
auth.deviceKey.rebindNotCurrent: The server didn't move this key to this sign-in. Reload the list and try again.
auth.deviceKey.noSession: This sign-in can't move keys. Sign out and sign in again.
auth.deviceKey.workHostNotRunning: This Mac's work host isn't running. Turn it on and try again.
auth.deviceKey.workHostOtherWorkspace: This Mac's work host belongs to another workspace, so it can't be changed here.
auth.deviceKey.workdRefused: This Mac's work host didn't accept the request. Try again.
auth.deviceKey.endorseConflict: This Mac already approved a different key under this name, or the same key under another name. Reload the list to check.
auth.deviceKey.serverPasswordRequired: That password isn't correct. Enter this account's current password.
auth.deviceKey.serverLinkedSession: A device connected with a QR code can't be a signing device. Sign in with a password on this Mac, then register it.
auth.deviceKey.serverAlreadyRegistered: This key is already registered. Reload the list.
auth.deviceKey.serverLineageEnded: This sign-in can't register keys anymore. Sign in again.
auth.deviceKey.serverRebindRequired: This key is tied to a sign-in that has ended. Connect again.
auth.deviceKey.serverNotFound: The server no longer has this key. Reload the list and register it again.
auth.deviceKey.serverSignatureInvalid: The server didn't accept this device's signature. Check that the device clock is right and try again.
auth.deviceKey.serverRequiresLinkedSessi: This phone wasn't connected with a QR code, so it can't send commands. Connect it once with a QR code from a Mac.
auth.deviceKey.serverLinkNotFromMac: This phone was connected with a QR code shown somewhere other than a Mac. Connect again with a QR code from a Mac.
